functions.description: Replies with the balance of the customer linked to the sender's number, from the Customer Trial Balance report, as on today or a date the sender gives.
functions.when_to_use: Customers asking how much they owe. Only the customer linked to the sender's contact is answered.

1.0.0.changelog: Port of the snd_accounting customer_balance API: the customer comes from the sender's linked contact and the reply is a template.

outputs.label: Balance
outputs.variables: data.customer_name, data.customer, data.balance, data.balance_formatted, data.currency, data.as_on

functions.description: Replies with the last entries of the sender's customer ledger (Customer Ledger report) over the last months, with the closing balance.
functions.when_to_use: Customers asking for their account statement. Only the customer linked to the sender's contact is answered.

1.0.0.changelog: Port of the snd_accounting customer_statement API as data and a reply template.

settings.label: Months back
settings.notes: Used when the message gives no number (1–24).

outputs.label: Statement
outputs.variables: data.customer_name, data.from_date, data.to_date, data.entries[].date / voucher / debit / credit / balance, data.count, data.closing_formatted

1.1.0.changelog: Each entry shows its debit and credit beside the balance, with a count line; the default period is 6 months instead of 3.
